test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of:: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : UEQ :: QAM : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : UEQ :: QAM : %

Option 1) ​# = CMY, % = ISE → CMY : UEQ :: QAM : ISE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59495e6d331ab9f0162b4aca1daf1dcbdf8a8f21fad2fcda5fd4a80928d66495.png] 

Option 2) # = FMY, % = ISE → FMY : UEQ :: QAM : ISE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45b2f0c4cdda84c2ba1a0fb3298d7a172256b22a22ab736303371ea730bba4be.png] 

Option 3) # = CMY, % = ISO → CMY : UEQ :: QAM : ISO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab615a8c69ae44397b2b48360047ea83bb2821896dd09edaae71f02a3a5c4966.png] 

Option 4) # = CMY, % = IUE → CMY : UEQ :: QAM : IUE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc502248d59c68fcfa8e7959ee9bf2014d35811684ea977bed8076caa67a2099.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
